notes:
### New
- **Upscale** (Edit → Upscale…) for low-resolution images: 300 dpi, ×2 or ×4 with AI – illustration, AI – photo
  or Classic. The print width stays, the dpi goes up; **Back to the original** undoes it.
- **Manual in all 12 languages** (Help → Manual, F1) – opens in your browser, works offline; F1 in Vynfera and
  Gang sheet opens their chapter.
- **Welcome window** on the first start: language, units and the update check, plus the three modules in short.
- **Help → Check for Updates…** and an optional check once a day at startup. Only the version number is fetched.
- **Help → Report a Problem** collects a description, system details and the log into one ZIP for support.
  Nothing is sent automatically.
- **About → Third-party licenses…** with the full license of every component and AI model.
- Vynfera: drag an image or project from Explorer into the window to open it.
- The installer is now also in Croatian; Portuguese is Brazilian Portuguese, as in the program.

### Same everywhere
- Preparation, Vynfera and Gang sheet now share the same menus, shortcuts, window titles, tool bar and status bar,
  with **File → Close**, **File → Open Recent**, **Help → Keyboard Shortcuts** and Settings in every module.
- **Shortcuts changed:** Ctrl+S saves the project or job, Ctrl+Shift+S = Save As, Ctrl+E exports, Ctrl+W closes
  the document, Ctrl+Alt+G sends to Gang sheet, Ctrl+, opens Settings, Ctrl+G groups in Gang sheet.
- **One Applika at a time:** opening a file while Applika runs opens it in the running program. A small
  "Applika is starting…" window appears right after the click.
- Windows remember their position, size and maximized state; the first time they open maximized.
- Gang sheet: **View → Preview quality** (Fast for slower computers and long rolls; export is always full quality);
  Save writes to the open job without asking.

### Fixed
- Downloading AI models (and the update check) failed on a freshly installed Windows with a certificate
  error. Applika now checks certificates through Windows itself, like a web browser.
- An unexpected error no longer goes unnoticed: it is shown in the status bar and written to the log.
- The installed program now writes its log (needed for problem reports).
- Restarting (e.g. after changing the language) could close Applika instead of restarting it.
- Smaller installer: the video component of OpenCV (FFmpeg) is no longer included.
